title: Canonical monoidal derived pullback of pro-etale internal modules
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, X and Y schemes, and f : X → Y. The left derived pullback L(f*Λ) on unbounded derived categories of internal module objects is strong monoidal. Its comonoidal tensor map is the universal left-derived tensor comparison, and its unit map is the derived counit on the unit followed by the ordinary unit comparison in degree zero. Both tensor counits are natural transformations, and the comparison between their two derived bifunctors is invertible.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3); canonical derived tensor construction as formalized by new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal

proof.text: Construct the homotopy tensor counit as the lax tensorator of Qh followed by Qh of the inverse natural comonoidal comparison for the exact monoidal pullback. Tensor the derived pullback counit in both arguments and compose with this homotopy counit. The opposite derived counit is the existing leftDerivedDerivedTensorCounit. Composition and whiskering prove all four naturality laws.

Identify pullback with mapModComap along the inverse of the coefficient comparison. Transport flatness along extendScalarsIsoComapInv and apply inverseImageModule_preservesFlat. On the kFlatMap left derivability structure, the tensor counit is invertible. The two-variable derived universal property gives the comparison, and uniqueness identifies it with an isomorphism of derived bifunctors.

Use the proved generic residueDerivedMonoidal construction. Its canonical tensor comparison and counit satisfy the lax square, its coherence descends along kFlatMap resolutions, and its tensor and unit maps are invertible. The unit of Qh is the identity. Expand the homotopy functor unit comparison and its single-complex comparison to identify the descended unit map with leftDerivedTensorUnitIso. Copy the monoidal structure using these equal explicit unit maps. Specialize this constructed structure to the exact monoidal pullback using the flatness result of the preceding step. The abstract leftDerivedLift_eq_of_inverse lemma cancels the postcomposed natural isomorphism in the universal property. This proves leftDerivedUpperStarTensor_eq_leftDerivedTensorComparison, identifying the original lift with the descended comonoidal map.
